decisions.statement: A turn runs from the turn start until the turn stops.
A seat's turn state is working or idle or stopped.
A seat's turn state is stamped when the turn state changes.
A seat is idle from the moment the seat is launched.
A seat with no turn record is stopped.
A seat with no session running is stopped.
A seat is working while its context is being compacted.
A turn end keeps its reading on the seat.
A turn end keeps its turn start source on the seat.
The record a turn end keeps is observed rather than declared.
The record a turn end keeps is there only while its seat is idle.
A turn ending does not itself stop the seat.
The halt guard may refuse a headless turn end.
The words a headless seat ends a turn with start nothing.
A turn end in a seat on call is read by a model.
Every other turn end is decided from state with no model called.
A turn end off call is refused only where nothing is arranged to come back to dispatched work.
A reading that cannot settle allows the turn end.
A state that cannot be read refuses the turn end.
Letting an agent go idle is a turn end approval.
Not letting an agent go idle is a turn end refusal.
A seat whose turn end was refused is working rather than idle.
A compaction ends a refused turn.
A refusal names the work the turn left undone rather than the question refusing the turn end.
A seat on call is refused a turn end short of the work the seat could do.
An error ends a turn rather than the agent ending the turn.
An error turn end follows refused credentials or an account at its limit.
An error turn end follows an overloaded model service or a failed connection.
No hook runs at an error turn end.
Nothing approves or refuses an error turn end.
An agent goes idle at an error turn end.
Only the transcript records that an error turn end happened.
When a seat whose credentials were refused can work again depends on the account.
When a seat the model service overloaded can work again depends on nothing but time.
When a seat whose connection failed can work again depends on nothing but time.
A turn ended by the agent emitting nothing further is an agent stopping.
A refused turn end starts another turn.
An allowed turn end starts nothing.
Restarting a seat restores the seat's session.
Restarting a seat starts no turn.
A turn start keeps its moment on the seat.
A message arriving starts a turn.
A turn start source is pending only where the seat has taken the act arming that source.
An idle seat is pending or handed or answered or unknown.
No idle seat is pending and handed and answered and unknown together.
An idle seat is pending while a turn start the seat arranged is still to come.
An idle seat is handed where the turn put the next act with the principal.
An idle seat is answered where the turn answered the principal's question.
An idle seat is unknown where nothing settled the turn's outcome.
Whether an idle seat is on call is read apart from which of those four the seat is.
Whether an idle seat is pending is read from the seat's own page and nothing else.
A subagent's turn is read from whether the page named for the subagent is there.
A subagent is never idle.
A subagent that has returned is stopped whatever the seat above the subagent is doing.
A subagent under a stopped seat is stopped.
A subagent's death announces itself to nothing.
A subagent's page is taken on the return or on the stop its seat asked for.
A subagent's page is taken where the seat starts fresh.
A stop is read from the request the seat made.
Stopping a subagent already gone still takes the subagent's page.
A subagent's turn ends by returning to the seat that ran the subagent.
Every turn state has the color the turn state is drawn in.
A seat states its turn state.
A turn ends only where the agent is blocked or has handed back.
Every error turn end is reported.
An overloaded seat is nudged until the seat works again.
A seat waits longer after each nudge.
A working seat is drawn in green.
An idle seat is drawn in yellow.
A seat in an on-call role between turns is drawn in green.
An idle seat off call with a turn start still to come is drawn in blue.
A stopped seat is drawn in the text color.
A reminder does not make a turn pending.

definition: whether an agent in a seat is working
